requires_external_validation.scope: Externally review moment extrema, causal proof and shared-bath finite-beta sensitivity. Acquire a justified genuinely quadratic environment class, full coupling-weighted matrix moments and uncertainties; implement outward-certified log determinants/tails plus correlated reference solves. Benchmark resulting decision margins and total costs against strongest same-input impurity/electronic-structure methods on an acquired consequential system, preserving fixed-sector and non-Gaussian boundaries.
